description: Native Windows edge dashboard with music controls, synced lyrics, system stats, and quick controls.
notes: Accepting Start with Windows copies Astraeus to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Astraeus and creates a separate Start Menu shortcut. Decline it to keep only the Scoop-managed copy.
The built-in updater can replace the executable independently of Scoop. Set AutoUpdate = false in astraeus.ini to manage updates with Scoop.
The release executable is unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may show an unknown-publisher warning.
